source.original_title: 05/20/2026 - Shane Goodell x Harry Edmonds KFS
source.display_title: 05/20/2026 - Shane Goodell x Harry Edmonds KFS  — Follow Up

setter.name: Kim Forbes-Sobers
setter.evidence: Kim said that you're my kind of guy, Shane

prospect.name: Shane Goodell
prospect.occupation: Self-employed carpenter; building a yoga / Tai Chi teaching business
prospect.family_status: Lives on family homestead in a tiny house he built; supporting his mother after her partner died of stage-four lung cancer
prospect.training_background: Former baseball pitcher and lifelong calisthenics; practices Kung Fu, Qigong and Tai Chi; currently running Trevor's free base kettlebell protocol at 12 kg plus posture alignment therapy through Head to Toe Healing
prospect.medical: Chronic right/left muscular imbalance from lifelong right-side overuse; severe shoulder pain two summers ago that stopped him working and is still being navigated; pelvis, shoulder and leg misalignment diagnosed by a posture-alignment program; knees felt 'clicky and tight' during kettlebell squats the day before the call; history of extreme weight loss (138 lb to 118 lb during a 10-day water fast) with muscle and tendon loss; injured himself previously by loading clubs and macebells too fast

signals: Lost his physical capacity to a shoulder injury and a period of severe undernutrition, and is explicitly rebuilding toward a former self
'I went from 118 pounds to 168 muscle, but it twisted everything up' — regret about how he rebuilt
Not price-insensitive: openly not in a position to invest today

goals.text: Build strength back the right way with no more setbacks after loading too fast injured him
Correct the left/right imbalance and load the weak left side safely
Master body in accordance with mind — be 'capable', the strongest version of himself
Be an example for children and build a healing community around his journey
Develop a yoga / Tai Chi teaching career through an online platform

pains.text: Intense right shoulder pain two summers ago that stopped him working and climbing his loft ladder
Lifelong right-side overuse and structural misalignment of pelvis, shoulder and leg
Avoided squatting and kettlebell work to shelter from pain, which only stiffened him further
Self-employed with three felony convictions limiting work options; income is seasonal and tight
Caretaking burden and financial shock after his mother's partner was diagnosed with stage-four lung cancer
Long-standing distractibility; needs physical exertion to focus

objections.raw_quote: And there's also a financial component.
objections.rep_response: Named the investment directly and asked whether he was in a position to invest, then accepted the answer without isolating or exploring financing

objections.raw_quote: So I'm hoping three or four months, maybe six at most.
objections.rep_response: Agreed to stay in touch on WhatsApp, offered to help him for free in the meantime, and did not run any timing play

evidence: Rep never presented pricing or tiers; call ended on a nurture note
'once I have my feet under the ground in a foundation, financially, that is when I would be happy to invest' — intent stated, timing deferred 3-6 months
'Let me text you on WhatsApp and we can stay in touch' — explicit continuation
Counter-evidence: no next call was booked and no date was set, so this could equally decay into a lost deal
outcome.next_step: Rep to message on WhatsApp and stay in touch informally; prospect estimates 3-6 months before he can invest

notable.note: Rep disengaged from the sales process almost immediately after the opening question and let the prospect talk for eight uninterrupted minutes, then spent several minutes trading anime recommendations. No baseline, no goals ladder, no consequence frame, no commitment check, no offer. The rep also volunteered free coaching help outside the paid programme, and gave the prospect his personal WhatsApp. Prospect has an active, documented postural injury and re-injured himself loading implements too fast; nobody asked whether a clinician had cleared loaded work.

quality.notes: Repeated inversions: at 00:08:04 'Jesus. I'm proud of you, man.' is attributed to the prospect's block but is the rep speaking; the 00:15:57/00:15:59 exchange about the financial component is inverted; several short back-channel turns near 00:21:20-00:21:47 are attributed to the wrong speaker. Role was read from content throughout.
